mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app.bank_account WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM app.bank_account WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.bank_account(employee_id, bank_code, branch_code, account_type, account_number_encrypted, account_number_hash, account_holder, account_holder_kana, is_primary, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{employeeId}, #{bankCode}, #{branchCode}, #{accountType}, #{accountNumberEncrypted}, #{accountNumberHash}, #{accountHolder}, #{accountHolderKana}, #{isPrimary}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE app.bank_account SET bank_code = #{bankCode}, branch_code = #{branchCode}, account_type = #{accountType}, account_holder = #{accountHolder}, account_holder_kana = #{accountHolderKana}, is_primary = #{isPrimary}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version = #{version}
